open_work: The original back bar/top and three original rear shelf runs retain their plan envelopes and upper datums. Six back-bar posts fill the .04m gap to the actual .01m floor; three narrow uprights seat the shelf assembly on the same source floor. Original hidden reference boxes remain unchanged.

Joined thin chrome end/side panels, hollow framed carcass and the same mapped 1.02m serving top replace the solid chrome body. All original urns, taps, gauges and pie case remain separate source owners; their actual seats on the new top are checked without inventing operating utilities or stock.

The five-centimetre source shelf depth remains literal. Three thin timber shelf runs join narrow floor-seated uprights within the same footprint. No invented back-bar cups, bottles, books, shelf loads or structural capacity.

Accepted native counter/ledger, register/cigar display, stools and both receivers retain their geometry and nonvisual authority. Serving operation, optical glare, utilities, continuous routes and human acceptance remain open.
